name: Tri gracii
source:
Three heroines of this story share only one connection - they all were acquainted with the girl named Mitsuki. When Mitsuki suddenly committed suicide, only those three girls knew the possible reason: one of them is responsible. 
All the heroines will tell their stories, showing the possible explanation of Mitsuki's suicide. Only one of the three is guilty. Can you guess who?
translation:
三名女主角唯一共同点，是都认识名为美月的女孩。当美月突然自杀，只有这三名女孩知道可能原因：其中一人应对此负责。

每位女主角都会讲述自己的故事，展现美月自杀的可能解释。三人中只有一人是凶手。你能猜出是谁吗？
